rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a tied bundle of items, including grain.

example.english: The farmer put a sheaf of wheat stalks by the door.
example.traditional: 農夫將一紮麥稈放喺門邊。
example.jyutping: nung4 fu1 zoeng1 jat1 zaat3 mak6 gon2 fong3 hai2 mun4 bin1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a tied bundle of grain stalks or straw.

example.english: Uncle tied a sheaf of rice straw after harvesting the rice.
example.traditional: 叔叔收割完啲稻穀，就綁咗一紮禾稈。
example.jyutping: suk1 suk1 sau1 got3 jyun4 di1 dou6 guk1 zau6 bong2 zo2 jat1 zaat3 wo4 gon2

rows.note: Use this for a sheaf or stack of papers and similar flat items.

example.english: I put a sheaf of papers on your desk.
example.traditional: 我執好一疊文件，擺喺你張枱面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zap1 hou2 jat1 dip6 man4 gin6 baai2 hai2 nei5 zoeng1 ci4 min6
